## CRM Sync from Transcripts v3

Reads all Google Docs in the transcripts folder, extracts CRM fields via Claude Haiku (55 fields across G1–G9), then creates or updates records in Attio.

**Google Drive folder:** 1W3wLJTBeXuFcBaWVNpCHnyenFIoc2gRY
**Attio list:** 4bd161bd-2b58-4c11-9ee5-004257444bb2

**Before deploying:** Run tools/attio-setup/create-fields.sh to create the custom fields in Attio.

**Groups:** G1 Identity · G2 Travel Prefs · G3 Financial · G4 Blockers · G5 Current Trip · G6 Milestones · G7 JTBD · G8 Engagement · G9 Actions & Intelligence
